_comment: Human-curated PRESENTATION settings only. Nothing here changes a measured
quantity: these keys trim the window, nudge the camera and pick which
space layer to shade, exactly the way a video editor would. Scientific
inputs (roles, tracking, the residual-space formula) are untouched.
Unlisted scenes fall back to the defaults in sources/annotation_scene.py.
